patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I wanted to help make pancakes and touched the hot pan. My hand is red and puffy, and it stings.
presentation.triageNote: 4-year-old girl with a small superficial partial-thickness contact burn to the right palm, approximately 1% of body surface area. Small blisters are present; sensation, circulation, and movement remain intact.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable small hand burn is expected to require one focused treatment resource for burn care and pain management.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This child has a small, painful partial-thickness burn confined to the palm, with intact hand function and circulation.
clinical.acuityReason: The palm location deserves careful assessment, but the burn is small, noncircumferential, and has no evidence of inhalation injury or neurovascular impairment.
keyFindings: Small blistered area on the right palm
teachingPoints: Hand burns require assessment of depth, movement, sensation, and circulation even when the total area is small.
Circumferential injury, deep tissue damage, electrical exposure, or inhalation findings would increase concern.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The hand would likely be cooled if still appropriate, cleaned, dressed with a nonadherent dressing, and treated for pain, followed by discharge with burn-care and infection precautions.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, holding her red hand up, protecting it
signs: right palm red with small blisters
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 4-year-old girl in a t-shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, holding her right hand up and protecting it. Expression: teary but calming down. Clearly visible: the right palm is red with small blisters. No text, no logos.
